ai_analysis.analysis: 2025财年Intelligent Cloud收入106,265百万美元，同比增长21%
ai_analysis.basis: 片段中SEGMENT RESULTS OF OPERATIONS显示Intelligent Cloud Revenue 2025年为$106,265百万，2024年为$87,464百万，同比21%。

ai_analysis.analysis: 2025财年Intelligent Cloud经营利润44,589百万美元，同比增长18%
ai_analysis.basis: 片段中SEGMENT RESULTS OF OPERATIONS显示Intelligent Cloud Operating Income 2025年为$44,589百万，2024年为$37,813百万，同比18%。
片段Highlights显示Server products and cloud services revenue increased 23% driven by Azure and other cloud services revenue growth of 34%。

ai_analysis.analysis: 微软持续投资云与AI基础设施及训练，以支持云服务增长
ai_analysis.basis: 片段称“We will continue to invest in capital expenditures to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure and training”，并提到在Cloud and AI infrastructure领域取得进展。

ai_analysis.analysis: 管理层预计现有现金、现金流及资本市场渠道足以满足未来至少12个月及可预见未来的运营、投资和融资承诺
ai_analysis.basis: 片段中LIQUIDITY AND CAPITAL RESOURCES部分称“We expect existing cash... to continue to be sufficient to fund our operating activities and cash commitments... for at least the next 12 months and thereafter for the foreseeable future.”

ai_analysis.analysis: 2023年云计算收入CNY55,287百万，同比+21.9%；2024年含其他华为分部云收入CNY68,801百万
ai_analysis.basis: 片段中2023年报显示Cloud Computing 55,287 45,342 21.9%；2024年报显示cloud computing business including revenue from other Huawei segments amounted to CNY68,801 million。

ai_analysis.analysis: 2023年云计算收入同比增长21.9%
ai_analysis.basis: 片段中2023年报显示Cloud Computing 55,287 45,342 21.9%。
